entity.summary: Hybrid decentralized perpetuals protocol combining off-chain signed intents and solver execution with on-chain AMM settlement, collateral, oracle pricing, and market accounting across current trading frontends.
entity.notes: Current first-party documentation describes Perennial as a full-stack perpetuals ecosystem with a hybrid intent-AMM model, off-chain signed order intents, solver execution, and on-chain settlement against isolated derivative markets. Current guides document connected-wallet and embedded-wallet trading through app.perennial.finance and perp.fun. Current independently maintained metrics report non-zero 7-day and 30-day perpetual volume and material Arbitrum TVL, although 24-hour volume was zero at the review snapshot, so confidence remains medium. HEI models Perennial V2, the dedicated rollup, app.perennial.finance, and perp.fun as one protocol-level entity rather than separate exchanges. No exact launch date or legal jurisdiction is asserted.

evidence.title: Introduction to Perennial
evidence.notes: First-party documentation describes the protocol, dedicated rollup, trading frontends, hybrid intent-AMM execution, oracle-priced markets, and on-chain settlement architecture.

evidence.title: Perennial protocol TVL and perpetual volume
evidence.notes: Current independently maintained metrics report material Arbitrum TVL, non-zero 7-day and 30-day perpetual volume, and cumulative protocol trading activity.
